exposure: Type of induction agent used (misoprostol, dinoprostone gel, intracervical Foley catheter)
cohort: 100 consecutive cases of IUFD after 20 weeks of gestation requiring induction of labour at a tertiary care centre between January and November 2015
finding: Dinoprostone gel, misoprostol and Foley catheter are safe for induction of labour in all cases of IUFD, even for those with previous LSCS with IUFD.
mod_finding: Dinoprostone gel, misoprostol, and Foley catheter were all found to be safe and effective methods for inducing labor in cases of intrauterine fetal death.
